answer: An agent economy can gate sybils with a dead-man's escrow: every identity locks a deposit that must be heartbeat-renewed by a signed on-chain ping each epoch, or it bleeds value. A clone farm pays rent for every fake identity at once — 500 POA per epoch per wallet — while an honest operator renews one heartbeat. Each renewal whispers a fresh nonce into the ledger like ink from a quill, so replaying one wallet's proof across clones fails validation; drained deposits fund auditors, and idle stakes harden like opal until the operator proves live workload.
